raw_posts.name: Tiden
raw_posts.description: Tiden verifies your coding agents built what you actually asked for. Most checks run inside the session that wrote the code, so the tests agree with it by construction. Tiden keeps your intent as requirements that branch and merge like code, and checks every change against that record. The verdict comes from tests run in your environment; no model grades the diff. You decide what merges, and production errors trace back to the release. Works beside Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot.

raw_posts.name: Confidence by Spotify
raw_posts.tagline: Build products at full speed, with both hands on the wheel

raw_posts.name: Reason
raw_posts.tagline: A state-of-the-art coding agent for cost efficiency
raw_posts.description: Reason is the best coding agent, in the cloud or locally. Give it a task and it writes code, runs tests and opens a pull request. raw_posts.name: Exodus for Google Cloud Run
raw_posts.tagline: Upgrade any app to Cloud Run, with your coding agent
raw_posts.description: Cloud Run is Google's managed platform: no servers to look after, new copies in seconds under load, a bill only while your code works. Then the agent makes the move, task by task, or designs a new app for Cloud Run. Free and open source. Try it on your repo today.

raw_posts.name: AirJelly
